_meta.what: CU4 Megalo variant bitstream grammar, as HaloSimulation_tag_release.dll CU4 reads it. Read by blam_megalo::raw (decode and encode) and blam_megalo::dump.
_meta.binary: HaloSimulation_tag_release.dll CU4 (image base 0x180000000); addresses are RVAs
_meta.decoder: 0x392a40 (Megalo variant vtable 0x83c3b8 slot 5); o = variant object = game-options variant + 4
_meta.bit_order: MSB-first; the reader (0x2abe70) loads big-endian 64-bit words; u(n) returns the next n bits

conventions.enum: enum keys are the decoded value: for minus1 fields that is read-1 (key "-1" = raw 0), the same convention as grammar/actions.json
conventions.bits_enum: flag names for a field read as one number: key = bit value
conventions.opt: one bit; 1 = absent (store -1/0xff), 0 = u(bits) follows; present_if:1 inverts the bit
conventions.zstring: chars of char_bits read until a 0 char is read or max chars are read; max without a 0 sets the stream error flag
conventions.repeat.count / bytes.count: an integer, or the name of an earlier field in the same struct
conventions.if.when: '<field> <op> <value>' over earlier fields (stored values, after minus1); ops == != < <= > >= in (comma list) & (bit test)
conventions.f32: 32 bits MSB-first reinterpreted as an IEEE float
conventions.store: where CU4 keeps the value, relative to o
conventions.clamp: CU4 replaces out-of-range values as stated; the bits read are unchanged
conventions.max: store capacity / RVE limit; CU4's decoder does not enforce it unless a clamp says so

action_conventions.action_type: u7 read first by 0x39cf20; 0 = none; 1..106 dispatch; 107..127 read no parameters (JA past the table) and the executor ignores them
action_conventions.record: 20 bytes per action (16 parameter bytes, type byte at +0x10)
action_conventions.minus1: stored value = read value - 1; selector cases and 'when' tests use the stored value
action_conventions.core_refs: NUMBER 0x421a00, PLAYER 0x41fab0, OBJECT 0x422640, TEAM 0x420480, TIMER 0x4239e0, VAR 0x4227d0 (defined in grammar/operands.json)
action_conventions.enum_on_flags: a field with "flags": true is a bit mask; its enum keys are bit values, not whole values
action_conventions.status: status is exactly VERIFIED or INFERRED; qualifiers are in status_note
doc_corrections: 107 action types, ids 0..106 (u7; 0 = none; 1..106 dispatched through 106-entry tables; 106 = Hide Object is live)
actions 30 and 31 read PLAYER + NUMBER (Get Death Damage Type / Modifier); only 99 reads a TRIGGER_BLOCK (docs/re/megalo_variant_format.md lists 30, 31, 99 as trigger blocks, which is wrong)
math operator 9 assigns ~b (0x40879d: mov edx,r9d; not edx), not a & ~b; operators 13..15 run past the 13-entry table 0x4087c4
action_conventions.player_biped_operands: actions 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10, 22, 53, 85 treat OBJECT operand kinds 4..7 (player-biped forms) as the player: waypoint/shape go to the player record (0x41c7b0, 0x41cb00)

_meta.cases_from: a union whose cases are the entries of the named top-level list (id -> params)
_meta.string_ref: the value indexes the main string table of the variant (STRINGS(7,15,15))
_meta.hint: names a reach_names table: ReachVariantTool names for the value (Halo Reach lists; a hint for CU4, not verified)
sources: operands.json and actions.json by the grammar-rest and grammar-actions research passes, 2026-10-21, read from the CU4 decoder 0x392a40, 0x39cf20 and their callees
names: ReachVariantTool (https://github.com/DavidJCobb/ReachVariantTool), names and ids only
_meta.maintenance: First built 2026-10-21 by merging the two research files (CONDITION and ACTION unions from the condition and action lists, actions 107..127 and conditions 18..31 filled in, hint, string_ref and trait weapon names added). Edit this file directly from now on: crates/blam-megalo/tests/roundtrip.rs is the judge (MCC_REACH=<MCC haloreach folder> round-trips every Bungie Megalo variant bit for bit).
_meta.verified_by: bit-identical round trip of all 417 Megalo variants in MCC haloreach/game_variants and hopper_game_variants (each decodes to within the last byte of its payload, trailing bits zero), the output of MJOLNIR builders and tools/tests/fixtures

fields.name: string

fields.name: tokens

VECTOR3.reader: 0x39e0e0 (one 24-bit read split MSB-first into 3 bytes); writer 0x2abb30(..., 0x18)

SHAPE.note: each NUMBER is scaled by 0.1 and clamped to [0, 200] world units by 0x41cb00

fields.name: icon

fields.name: territory

TRIGGER_BLOCK.reader: 0x423cb0 (same reader as a trigger header's tail); writer 0x423b60
TRIGGER_BLOCK.note: indices into the variant's flat condition and action arrays, not inline opcodes

conditions.name: None
conditions.semantics: reads nothing else; evaluates true

conditions.name: Compare
conditions.semantics: number/timer: signed compare by operator via 0x423f60 (table 0x423f9c: setl, setg, sete, setle, setge, setne; operators 6 and 7 index past the table: crash); player/object/team: operator 2 is ==, any other operator is !=; b is resolved as a's type when a is player/object/team

conditions.name: Object In Boundary
conditions.semantics: true when a's centre is inside b's boundary shape; b may be a biped kind (4..7)

conditions.name: Killer Type
conditions.semantics: finds the victim in this tick's death records (engine globals +0x159c count, 16-byte entries at +0x15a4) and tests bit (1 << record byte +0xa) of the flags

conditions.name: Team Alliance Status
conditions.semantics: either team neutral (8): status==0; either none: status==2; else status == (a!=b)+1

conditions.name: Timer Is Zero
conditions.semantics: timer value & 0xffffff == 0

conditions.name: Object Type

params.name: type
params.note: multiplayer object type list index; bit 1 = none

conditions.semantics: object's tag index equals the tag of multiplayer object type list entry [type]

conditions.name: Team Has Players
conditions.semantics: if the variant's o+0xf83e bool (vt+0x40, RVE fireteams_enabled) is set: true for team designators 0 and 1; else 0x20bb00 maps the designator to a game team and 0x20b970 tests it has players

conditions.name: Object Out Of Bounds
conditions.semantics: 0x424150(object)

conditions.name: Player Is Fireteam Leader
conditions.semantics: resolves the player and returns false (no-op)

conditions.name: Player Assisted Kill Of
conditions.semantics: victim's death record this tick has the attacker's bit set in its assist mask (+0xc)

conditions.name: Object Has Label

params.name: label
params.note: object filter index; bit 1 = none

conditions.semantics: object matches object filter [label] (o+0xe4e0 + label*0x10) via 0x424460; none -> false

conditions.name: Player Is Not Respawning
conditions.semantics: player datum flags (+4): bit 1 clear and bit 0 set

conditions.name: Equipment In Use
conditions.semantics: object is equipment (type 3) and its active field (+0x1c8) is not -1

conditions.name: Species Is Monitor
conditions.semantics: 0x2fedc0(player, 0)

conditions.name: In Forge
conditions.semantics: true when a game engine exists, game options mode byte == 3 and 0x2b5520() == 1

actions.name: None
actions.semantics: type 0: the decoder zeroes the 16 parameter bytes and reads nothing; the executor returns before its switch

actions.name: Modify Score

params.name: operator
params.note: 0x408730 has a 13-entry jump table (0x4087c4); 13..15 jump past it (undefined). Actions 64, 65, 67, 68 apply only 0..4 themselves.

actions.semantics: 0x41c080: player score (s16, engine globals +0x32c0 + i*8) changed by the operator through 0x2b0200; team score at +0x3340 + t*8 clamped to +-30000; all players through the 0x41bf80 mask; skipped unless 0x2af760

actions.name: Create Object

params.name: type
params.note: index into the map's multiplayer object type list (motl); absent = -1

params.name: label
params.note: script label (object filter) index; absent = -1

params.name: flags
params.note: bit flags (0x41c3b0: bit0 sets object +0x133 bit0, bit1 clears creation flag 0x200, bit2 keeps the basis pitch/roll)

params.name: name
params.note: index into the map's Megalo string-id list (resolved by 0x36c1a0); 0 encodes none

actions.semantics: 0x41c3b0: creates the motl type at basis + offset*0.1 (yaw-only frame unless absolute_orientation), optional model variant name and label, stores the new object in result

actions.name: Delete Object
actions.semantics: deletes the object (0x5a2c30), first calling 0x5fae60 when its object type is in mask 0x1003

actions.name: Set Waypoint Visibility
actions.semantics: waypoint record (0x41c7b0: player record +0x390 when the OBJECT operand is a player-biped form, else megalo object +4) visibility player set via 0x40abd0, then dirty 0x41c850

actions.name: Set Waypoint Icon
actions.semantics: waypoint +0xa = icon (territory: 11 + clamp(n-1, 0, 8))

actions.name: Set Waypoint Priority
actions.semantics: waypoint +0x14 = priority (enum names INFERRED from RVE)

actions.name: Set Waypoint Timer

params.name: timer
params.note: object-scoped timer variable index; absent = -1

actions.semantics: waypoint +0x15 = object timer index

actions.name: Set Waypoint Distance
actions.semantics: waypoint +0x16/+0x17 = min/max range, capped at 100, negative stored as 0xff (none)

actions.name: Modify Variable

params.name: operator
params.note: 0x408730 has a 13-entry jump table (0x4087c4); 13..15 jump past it (undefined). Actions 64, 65, 67, 68 apply only 0..4 themselves.

actions.semantics: 0x41c8b0: number a = op(a, b) (a timer b is read as its value via 0x423580); player/object/team: a = b, operator ignored (team writes go through 0x41fd80); timer: copy or op on seconds*tickrate, clamped

actions.name: Set Object Shape
actions.semantics: 0x41cb00: writes the boundary into the object's shape block (object +0x182) or, for a player-biped operand, the player record +0x3a8; values *0.1 clamped [0, 200]

actions.name: Apply Player Traits

params.name: traits
params.note: scripted player-traits index (0..15)

actions.semantics: appends the traits index to the player's per-tick list (engine globals player record +0x3ec count, max 16, entries +0x3f4)

actions.name: Set Weapon Pickup Permissions
actions.semantics: megalo object (0x3f5bf0) +0x1c = player set; object dirty 0x4000

actions.name: Set Spawn Location Permissions
actions.semantics: if 0x41cd90 says the object is a spawn location: megalo object +0x24 = player set

actions.name: Set Spawn Location Fireteams

params.name: fireteams
params.note: fireteam bit mask

actions.semantics: if a spawn location: megalo object +2 = fireteam mask

actions.name: Set Object Progress Bar

params.name: timer
params.note: object timer index; absent = -1

actions.semantics: megalo object +0x88 = player set, +0x90 = timer index

actions.name: Kill Feed Message

params.name: sound
params.note: Megalo engine sound index (95 slots); 0 encodes none

actions.semantics: 0x41cdf0: per recipient formats the text (0x4229d0) with that player as context, merges identical messages, posts event 0x1e through 0x5132f0 (skipped when game options +0x11 == 4)
actions.decoder_note: case 16 falls through into case 18's FORMAT_STRING read (0x39d33e)

actions.name: Set Timer Rate

params.name: rate
params.note: rate table index; names INFERRED from RVE

actions.semantics: timer record (0x4235e0) +3 = rate index, then 0x4232e0

actions.name: Debug Print
actions.semantics: no-op in CU4 (empty handler)

actions.name: Get Item Carrier
actions.semantics: for a weapon or equipment (object type 2 or 3) reads the holder unit (+0x1a4) and its player (+0x1bc); always writes result (-1 when none)

actions.name: Run Nested Trigger

params.name: trigger
params.note: trigger index

actions.semantics: runs trigger (options +0x79f0 + i*0xc) through 0x39ed40, saving and restoring the engine-global iterator slots +0x1bc/+0x1c0/+0x1c4 around it

actions.name: End Round
actions.semantics: 0x2afa70(-1, 0, 0): ends the round (engine globals +0x845c = 2)

actions.name: Set Object Shape Visibility
actions.semantics: shape record (0x41d070) visibility = player set; player-biped operands mark the player, others the object

actions.name: Kill Object Instantly
actions.semantics: 0x41d160: applies a lethal damage event (0x5b8db0) unless object +0x128 bit 2 is set; silent sets damage flag 0x80 (no statistics, INFERRED)

actions.name: Set Object Invincibility
actions.semantics: object +0x128 bit 0x80 set when the number is non-zero, cleared when zero

actions.name: Random Number
actions.semantics: when cap > 0: LCG step on TLS +0x4b0 (x*0x19660d + 0x3c6ef35f), result = ((x>>16)*cap)>>16 in [0, cap)

actions.name: Break into Debugger
actions.semantics: no-op in CU4 (empty handler)

actions.name: Get Object Orientation
actions.semantics: result = 1..6, which object axis points most nearly up

actions.name: Get Speed
actions.semantics: result = round(|velocity| * 10), 0 below 0.1

actions.name: Get Killer
actions.semantics: searches this tick's death records (engine globals +0x159c count, 16-byte entries at +0x15a4: victim, killer +4, damage type +8, modifier +9) and writes the killer only when the victim is found

actions.name: Get Death Damage Type
actions.semantics: same records: result = damage type byte (+8); unchanged when not found

actions.name: Get Death Damage Modifier
actions.semantics: same records: result = damage modifier byte (+9); unchanged when not found

actions.name: Debugging: Enable Tracing
actions.semantics: no-op in CU4 (empty handler)

actions.name: Attach Objects
actions.semantics: 0x41d370: moves subject to target + offset*0.1 and attaches it to the nearest target node (0x5a51a0)

actions.name: Detach Objects
actions.semantics: 0x5a58a0 detaches the object

actions.name: Get Player Scoreboard Position
actions.semantics: 0x3f8d90(player, team game) -> result = pos/2 + 1, or 0

actions.name: Get Team Scoreboard Position
actions.semantics: result = 0x2aeef0(team) + 1

actions.name: Get Player Killstreak
actions.semantics: result = statistic 0x680000 of the player (0x2f3e10 -> TLS+0x68 +0x3a40 + i*0x1c), 0 when none

actions.name: Modify Player Requisition Money

params.name: operator
params.note: 0x408730 has a 13-entry jump table (0x4087c4); 13..15 jump past it (undefined). Actions 64, 65, 67, 68 apply only 0..4 themselves.

actions.semantics: money (0x42abd0) = op(money, operand) applied as a delta through 0x42aaa0

actions.name: Set Player Requisition Purchase Modes

params.name: flags
params.note: bit names INFERRED from RVE

actions.semantics: player record +0x3ba: the flag bits are set when enable != 0, cleared when 0

actions.name: Get Player Vehicle
actions.semantics: result = the vehicle (object type 1) the player's unit is in, else -1

actions.name: Force Player Into Vehicle
actions.semantics: vehicle of type 1: 0x189790 seats the player; vehicle none: issues unit action 0x19 to the player's unit (0x6286f0, exit vehicle INFERRED)

actions.name: Set Player Biped
actions.semantics: for an unowned biped (type 0): 0x183f10 + 0x189150 make it the player's unit

actions.name: Reset Timer
actions.semantics: timer value = its initial value (0x4231b0) clamped to [0, tickrate*0x6270]

actions.name: Set Weapon Pickup Priority

params.name: priority
params.note: names INFERRED from RVE

actions.semantics: weapons only (type 2): megalo object +3 = priority

actions.name: Push Object Up
actions.semantics: 0x41d8c0: random upward impulse from a table (0x845730) scaled by the object's mass terms

actions.name: Set Widget Text

params.name: widget
params.note: HUD widget index (0..3); absent = -1 (the executor does not range-check it)

actions.semantics: engine globals widget[i] (+0x2ac + i*0x28) = text; net bit 1<<(i+0x28)

actions.name: Set Widget Value Text

params.name: widget
params.note: HUD widget index (0..3); absent = -1 (the executor does not range-check it)

actions.semantics: widget[i] +0x2b6 = text

actions.name: Set Meter Parameters

params.name: widget
params.note: HUD widget index (0..3); absent = -1 (the executor does not range-check it)

actions.semantics: widget[i] +0x2c0/+0x2c4/+0x2c6 = meter parameters

actions.name: Set Widget Icon

params.name: widget
params.note: HUD widget index (0..3); absent = -1 (the executor does not range-check it)

params.name: icon
params.note: HUD widget icon index; absent = -1

actions.semantics: widget[i] +0x2c8 = icon

actions.name: Set Widget Visibility

params.name: widget
params.note: HUD widget index (0..3); absent = -1 (the executor does not range-check it)

actions.semantics: widget[i] +0x2a8 per-player bit set or cleared

actions.name: Play Sound

params.name: sound
params.note: Megalo engine sound index (95 slots); 0 encodes none

actions.semantics: posts event 0x1e (0x5132f0) with the sound, immediate flag and recipient mask (0x41bf80), unless options +0x11 == 4

actions.name: Modify Object Scale
actions.semantics: 0x59fc40(object, max(0, scale*0.01)); dirty 0x1000

actions.name: Set Waypoint Text
actions.semantics: waypoint text: player record +0x390 for a player-biped operand, else megalo object +4

actions.name: Get Object Shields
actions.semantics: result = clamp(shield vitality 0x5b8230, 0, 4) * 100

actions.name: Get Object Health
actions.semantics: result = clamp(health vitality 0x5b7e60, floor, 1) * 100 (floor 0.01 when object +0x128 bit 2 is clear)

actions.name: Set Objective Description for Player
actions.semantics: player record +0x3bc = text (if changed), stamps +0x3d8, net 0x8000000

actions.name: Set Objective Icon Caption for Player
actions.semantics: player record +0x3cc = text (if changed)

actions.name: Set Objective Icon for Player

params.name: icon
params.note: engine icon index; absent = -1

actions.semantics: player record +0x3c8 = icon (if changed)

actions.name: Enable/Disable Co-Op Spawning
actions.semantics: every player on the team: player record +0x3dc = enable; then 0x516570(team, 4)

actions.name: Set Primary Respawn Object for Team
actions.semantics: 0x41daf0: for team players allowed by the object's spawn permissions (megalo object +0x24 type, +2 fireteams) sets the respawn object via 0x1974d0

actions.name: Set Primary Respawn Object for Player
actions.semantics: 0x1974d0(player, object) when permitted; object none clears it

actions.name: Get Player Fireteam
actions.semantics: result = player data +0x4a4 (0 when none)

actions.name: Set Player Fireteam
actions.semantics: 0x1975d0(player, index) when index < 17

actions.name: Modify Object Shields

params.name: operator
params.note: 0x408730 has a 13-entry jump table (0x4087c4); 13..15 jump past it (undefined). Actions 64, 65, 67, 68 apply only 0..4 themselves.

actions.semantics: shield vitality op (operand*0.01, ops 0..4 only) clamped [0, 4]; skipped when object +0x128 bit 2 is set

actions.name: Modify Object Health

params.name: operator
params.note: 0x408730 has a 13-entry jump table (0x4087c4); 13..15 jump past it (undefined). Actions 64, 65, 67, 68 apply only 0..4 themselves.

actions.semantics: 0x41dd00: health vitality op clamped [0, 1]; at 0 applies a lethal damage event

actions.name: Get Distance
actions.semantics: result = round(distance * 10); 0 when either object is none

actions.name: Modify Object Max Shields

params.name: operator
params.note: 0x408730 has a 13-entry jump table (0x4087c4); 13..15 jump past it (undefined). Actions 64, 65, 67, 68 apply only 0..4 themselves.

actions.semantics: object +0x10c (max shields) op, floored, min 0; current shields rescaled

actions.name: Modify Object Max Health

params.name: operator
params.note: 0x408730 has a 13-entry jump table (0x4087c4); 13..15 jump past it (undefined). Actions 64, 65, 67, 68 apply only 0..4 themselves.

actions.semantics: object +0x108 (max health) op, floored, min 0; 0 kills (0x5b8f50)

actions.name: Set Player Requisition Palette

params.name: palette
params.note: requisition palette index

actions.semantics: player record +0x1ff = palette (values > 12 become 0)

actions.name: Set Device Power
actions.semantics: device (0x408880) power = clamp(power*0.01, 0, 1) via 0x5baea0

actions.name: Get Device Power
actions.semantics: result = clamp(power*100, 0, 100), 0 when not a device

actions.name: Set Device Position
actions.semantics: device position = clamp(position*0.01, 0, 1) via 0x5bad40

actions.name: Get Device Position
actions.semantics: result = clamp(position*100, 0, 100)

actions.name: Modify Player Grenades

params.name: type
params.note: names INFERRED from RVE

params.name: operator
params.note: 0x408730 has a 13-entry jump table (0x4087c4); 13..15 jump past it (undefined). Actions 64, 65, 67, 68 apply only 0..4 themselves.

actions.semantics: unit +0x382 + type grenade count = op(count, operand) clamped [0, 4]; 0x613800 on change

actions.name: Submit Incident

params.name: incident
params.note: incident index (n-th entry of the iterator 0x36b5d0); 0 encodes none

actions.semantics: 0x41df50(incident, cause, affected, 0): looks up the n-th incident definition and posts it (0x2f4510)

actions.name: Submit Incident with value

params.name: incident
params.note: incident index; 0 encodes none

actions.semantics: 0x41df50 with value (out-of-range s16 becomes 0)

actions.name: Set Player Loadout Palette

params.name: palette
params.note: names INFERRED from RVE

actions.semantics: 0x41e140: player -> 0x2f10e0(player, palette); team -> player data +0x3f8 for each team member, then loadout refresh

actions.name: Set Device Position Track

params.name: animation
params.note: index into the map's Megalo string-id list (resolved by 0x36c1a0); 0 encodes none

actions.semantics: 0x5bcc90(device, string id, position)

actions.name: Animate Device Position
actions.semantics: 0x5bd880: animate to clamp(target*0.01, 0, 1) over the given seconds

actions.name: Set Device Actual Position
actions.semantics: 0x5bb070(device, clamp(position*0.01, 0, 1))

actions.name: Insert Theater Film Marker
actions.semantics: 0x41e310: when a film is recording, appends an ASCII marker (max 32) at time + offset*tickrate

actions.name: Enable/Disable Spawn Zone
actions.semantics: spawn-zone record (0x5b52a0) +0x12 bit 0x4000 cleared when enable != 0, set when 0

actions.name: Get Player Weapon
actions.semantics: result = the chosen weapon of the player's unit, else -1

actions.name: Get Player Armor Ability
actions.semantics: result = 0x608740(unit, 2), else -1

actions.name: Enable/Disable Object Garbage Collection
actions.semantics: object +0x133 bit 0 = (disable != 0); a player-biped operand only evaluates the number

actions.name: Get Player Target Object
actions.semantics: result = the unit's aim target object (unit +0x2ab block, kind 1 with flag 4), else -1

actions.name: Create Object Equidistant

params.name: type
params.note: index into the map's multiplayer object type list (motl); absent = -1

actions.semantics: 0x41e540: creates the type at the midpoint of a and b oriented along a->b; radius*0.1 and half the distance go into the creation data; stores the object in result
actions.decoder_note: the type is read third but stored at +0

actions.name: Debug: Force Splitscreen Count
actions.semantics: no-op in CU4 (empty handler)

actions.name: Add Weapon to Player
actions.semantics: if the object is a weapon (type 2): 0x609bc0(unit, weapon, 1)

actions.name: Set Co-op Spawning for Player
actions.semantics: player record +0x220 = enable (via 0x404620), net 0x10000000

actions.name: Copy Object Rotation
actions.semantics: 0x41e810: an unattached a takes b's full orientation (all_axes) or only its forward rotated about a's up

actions.name: Point Object Toward Object
actions.semantics: 0x41eb90: turns an unattached a to face b's position + offset*0.1 (b frame)

actions.name: Add Weapon To Biped

params.name: weapon
params.note: index into the map's multiplayer object type list (motl); absent = -1

params.name: mode
params.note: 0x41ef90 maps 0 -> 3, 1 -> 0, 2 -> 1 for 0x609bc0; 3 -> 0; names INFERRED from RVE

actions.semantics: 0x41ef90: creates the weapon type and gives it to a biped (type 0) that does not already hold that type; deletes it if the give fails

actions.name: Remove Weapon From
actions.semantics: 0x6098c0(biped, weapon, delete) for a biped (type 0)

actions.name: Set Scenario Interpolator State
actions.semantics: 0x41f1d0: for which in 1..32, id which+0x23e: turns it on (0x35b360) or off (0x35b440) when the state differs
actions.status_note: control flow VERIFIED; interpolator meaning INFERRED (RVE)

actions.name: Get Random Object With Label

params.name: label
params.note: script label (object filter) index; absent = -1

actions.semantics: 0x41f350: random member (LCG) of the label's object list (engine globals +0x155c + l*4, linked via megalo data +0x44), excluding exclude; writes -1 when empty

actions.name: Record Griefer Penalty
actions.semantics: 0x35d530(player, number*0.01)

actions.name: Set Shape Owner

params.name: player_var
params.note: object-scoped player variable index; absent = -1

actions.semantics: shape record (0x41d070) +8 = player variable index, then 0x41d110 (shape colour follows that player)

actions.name: Run Inline Nested Trigger
actions.semantics: runs the referenced condition/action range through the sequencer 0x423a70 against the script (0x4046a0 + 0x63f4)

actions.name: Call HaloScript Function

params.name: function
params.note: index into the map's Megalo string-id list (resolved by 0x36c1a0); 0 encodes none

actions.semantics: maps the index to a string id (0x36c1a0), looks up the scenario script by it (0x1f6b60) and runs it (0x1fcf30)
actions.status_note: grammar and the call chain VERIFIED; script lookup/run naming of 0x1f6b60/0x1fcf30 INFERRED

actions.name: Get Button Press Duration

params.name: button
params.note: names INFERRED from RVE; the handler switches on 0..13

actions.semantics: result = a per-player input timing byte chosen by button from tables at 0x1814311e8.. (decompile truncated)
